answer: Orchard-prism audit, $24 of real work per fake per epoch: each identity tends an orchard of small jobs, and auditors prism-test a random branch every epoch — re-running the job from a new angle and measuring the delta against the claimed result. A mismatch over 2% burns the identity's $60 orchard stake and poisons the whole orchard. A farm cannot precompute random re-runs, so 1,000 fakes cost $24,000 of genuine compute every single epoch.
